A carefully composed miniature coastal business district, abstract outdoor advertising surfaces with blank matte panels, a precise physical navy blue account card and a small restrained red marker showing a path from district to opportunity. No people. Materials: warm off-white architectural paper, navy #0A2240 metal, discreet red #CE0E2D accent. Soft neutral studio daylight, tactile surfaces, realistic architectural model rendering, restrained executive art direction. One clear focal point, asymmetric composition with generous negative space. Absolutely no text, numbers, brands, logos, screens pretending real data, purple or blue gradients, glow, neon, floating particles or lens flare. It must visibly be an illustrative architectural model, not documentation of a real customer or location. This will sit beside live HTML product UI, not replace it. High quality 1536x864 landscape.

Premium tactile material realism, soft side-lit neutral daylight, architectural product rendering. Clean composition with room for live HTML labels added later. No water or coastline, no real city, no identifiable landmark, no maps or geography, no people, no text or numbers, no words, no logos, no brand marks, no bank or credit cards, no actual data, no fabricated screenshots.
